headline: Vermont says Valcour still has no restore date and it is looking at other dispatch systems in the meantime.
summary: Added s012, the Nov 24 statement from Vermont's Public Safety Commissioner: investigations by the state, federal partners and CrossWind remain active; no restore timeline; DPS evaluating alternative computer-aided-dispatch systems (new c023, Confirmed); biggest public impact is on records requests (new c024, Confirmed).
